items.question: If the patient has no mobile number on file, is the referral still made without the AC3 text message, or does the doctor have to add a number first?

items.reason: one request; the referral is saved before the clinic is told

items.quote: Paper referrals from before go-live are not moved into the system
The text message goes out in the language set in the patient's profile

items.reason: a new referral lengthening the clinic's wait is what the waiting list is for
